aboutBody:
Hi, I’m Nida.

I made Bookhearth because I wanted a place for the things I keep coming back to: books, stories, reading lists, and my own writing.

I’ve always been someone who keeps track of books. The ones I loved, the ones I struggled to finish, the ones I keep thinking about months later, and the ones I want to read someday. I also write short stories, mostly for myself, and I wanted somewhere to keep them instead of leaving them scattered across documents and notebooks.

So this is my little corner for all of that.

You’ll find my book reviews, what I’m currently reading, books I want to read, and some of the stories I’ve written along the way.

I don’t have a particular reading philosophy and I’m certainly not trying to be an expert critic. These are simply my thoughts as a reader and writer. Sometimes I’ll have a lot to say about a book. Sometimes I’ll have very little. And sometimes I’ll probably change my mind later.

If you enjoy books and stories, I hope you find something here that makes you want to pick up a book, or perhaps write something of your own.

Welcome to Bookhearth.

currentlyReadingNote: The struggle of a man who has built his life around freedom, only to find himself dissatisfied with the emptiness that freedom can bring. Mathieu wants to remain unattached and in control, yet the more he protects his freedom, the more uncertain he becomes about what to do with it.
